title: Course Outline
summary: The professional training path to becoming a Zura Wellness Professional — mindset, routines, standards, technique, and client experience.

sections.title: About This Course
paragraphs: The Zura Wellness Professional Course prepares therapists to deliver the complete Zura Spa experience — not only massage technique, but professionalism, hygiene, client care, emotional intelligence, and continuous improvement.
A Zura Wellness Professional is not just a massage therapist. A Zura Wellness Professional understands wellness, client comfort, discipline, teamwork, and the Zura Spa standard.
This course brings together the identity, routines, standards, and practical skills every therapist is expected to learn, practise, demonstrate, and master.

sections.title: Course Objective
paragraphs: By completing this course, therapists should be able to:
list: Understand the professional identity of a Zura Wellness Professional.
Adopt the Wellness Professional mindset: prepared, responsible, attentive, professional, and ready to serve.
Follow Zura Spa routines from preparation through massage end and client departure.
Uphold Zura Spa standards of appearance, communication, accountability, and teamwork.
Deliver consistent client care with correct pressure, hygiene, boundaries, and coordination.
Demonstrate competence through supervised practice and assessment until the standard becomes natural.

sections.title: Module 1 — Wellness Professional Identity & Mindset
paragraphs: Learn who a Zura Wellness Professional is and why the role exists.
Study the Daily Staff Recitation and Wellness Professional Declaration.
Practise the five daily thoughts: I am prepared. I am responsible. I am attentive. I am professional. I am here to serve.
Develop a growth mindset and a problem-solving mindset so correction becomes improvement, not conflict.

sections.title: Module 2 — Appearance, Hygiene & Professional Presence
paragraphs: Master the Appearance Standard: uniform, hair, hands, nails, breath, body odour, footwear, and accessories.
Complete the Freshen-Up Routine consistently before and during sessions.
Understand that professional appearance is part of the service itself — your presentation speaks before your hands do.

sections.title: Module 3 — Session Routines
paragraphs: Learn and practise the full session flow:
list: Pre-Massage Routine — room and therapist readiness.
Massage Start Routine — privacy, positioning, cleaning, pressure, rhythm, and 4-hands sync.
Mid-Session Routine — comfort check, turn, freshen-up, and continue.
Massage End Routine — close, cover, privacy, feedback, and room reset.
Post-Massage Routine — linen, products, equipment, and hygiene.
Client reception, handover, take-over, and departure routines.

sections.title: Module 4 — Client Care & Communication
paragraphs: Communicate enough to understand, reassure, and guide — without disturbing relaxation.
Practise mode of address for clients, leaders, and colleagues.
Handle client requests, concerns, and Lunez Massage requests through approved procedure.
Protect confidentiality, dignity, and professional boundaries at every stage.

sections.title: Module 5 — Teamwork, Accountability & Operations
paragraphs: Work as a team: support without covering up; care without unhealthy dependence.
Own assigned tasks, report completion, communicate blockers, and escalate appropriately.
Keep every session visible through the Massage Task & Update Channel.
Protect company property, stock, and the shared Zura Spa standard.

sections.title: Module 6 — Assessment & Mastery
paragraphs: Use the Assessment Routine to learn, practise, demonstrate, and master Zura Spa skills.
Build competence through supervised repetition until technique, pressure, communication, room movement, and 4-hands coordination become consistent.
Accept feedback with a teachable mindset: Listen → Understand → Practise → Correct → Improve.
Progress from learning → practice → competence → mastery.

sections.title: How to Use This Course
paragraphs: Study each module alongside the related handbook articles, routines, and standards.
Practise under supervision before working independently with paying clients.
Ask for clarification when unsure. Escalate when the matter is beyond your authority.
Revisit modules anytime — growth is continuous, and mastery requires repetition.

sections.title: Zura Wellness Professional Standard
paragraphs: PREPARE → CARE → COMMUNICATE → DELIVER → ACCOUNT → IMPROVE
At Zura Spa, excellence is not something expected only when management is present. It is the standard we choose to demonstrate every day.
We do not just recite the Zura standard — we live it.
